description: This file defines the SearchModules class within the SuiteCRM project. It handles functionalities related to retrieving, caching, and managing search modules and their display settings, including enabling/disabling modules for global search, building cache files for module metadata, and saving user search preferences.

classes.name: SearchModules
classes.description: Class responsible for managing search modules, including retrieving, caching, displaying settings, and enabling/disabling modules for global search within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getModulesList
methods.description: Returns a list of all enabled and disabled search modules with their labels.

methods.name: getEnabledModules
methods.description: Returns a list of module names that are enabled for search.

methods.name: saveGlobalSearchSettings
methods.description: Saves the administrator's configuration for which modules are enabled for global search.

methods.name: getUnifiedSearchModulesDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves the display configuration for search modules, showing which are visible or hidden.

methods.name: getUnifiedSearchModules
methods.description: Returns metadata about modules supporting unified search, building cache if necessary.

methods.name: writeUnifiedSearchModulesDisplayFile
methods.description: Writes the display configuration of search modules to a file.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds cache files containing module definitions and search fields metadata used by the search system.

methods.name: getAllModules
methods.description: Returns an array of all modules used for global search, including enabled and disabled modules.
